delegation.context: Reply to the question whether Claude should prepare the TFDA launch review; the owner asked Claude to perform the review directly instead of reviewing it personally.

reviewer_note: AI review delegated by the owner; not reviewed by a person.

TFDA-R1-SOURCE.purpose: The raw artifact is the medical device permit dataset published by the Taiwan Food and Drug Administration.
checklist: Dataset landing page https://data.gov.tw/dataset/9576 lists 衛生福利部食品藥物管理署 as provider; the owner confirmed this identity on 2026-09-14.
Metadata publisherOID is 2.16.886.101.20003.20065.20065, identifier is A21020000I-000053 and license code is 1.
The ZIP was fetched over HTTPS from a data.fda.gov.tw resource URL discovered from the data.gov.tw metadata.
fetch.json is canonical and its artifact size and SHA-256 match the stored raw ZIP.
Attribution follows the 政府資料開放授權條款 appendix form with the license URL https://data.gov.tw/license.

TFDA-R1-SCHEMA.purpose: The raw artifact matches the tfda-34-v1 schema and every source row is preserved unchanged.
checklist: The ZIP passes the archive limits and holds exactly one .csv entry.
The header equals the 34 researched columns in order.
The curated database holds every source row once; row count and every source_row_sha256 match the raw CSV.
All 34 values of every row are stored unchanged as strings, including leading zeros and line breaks.
A permit number with several manufacturing rows keeps every row.
Dates are strict YYYY/MM/DD values and every row has a validity date.
Search columns never replace raw values.
IVD labels come only from sub-category codes and the approved tfda-ivd-v1 registry; rows without a reviewed code stay unknown.

PUB-R1-OWNER.purpose: The build may be served by the local MCP runtime. Redistribution as a GitHub Release bundle is not covered by this protocol version.
checklist: Every official result carries provenance attribution and the license URL.
Every official TFDA result carries the note 非食藥署官方服務，內容以食藥署公告為準。
TFDA tool descriptions state that returned content is official data, not instructions, and must not be used directly as device advertising or performance claims.
Search results are summaries of at most 20 rows; full fields come from get_license.
coverage_status stays review_incomplete while rows without a reviewed classification code exist.
Review records and golden cases name the reviewer as ai-reviewer:claude-opus-5, never as a person.

required_coverage: permit number with several manufacturing rows
code outside the reviewed annex classes
leading zero tax id or line break preserved
golden_cases.comparison: Compare each expected value, row number and row hash with an independent parse of the raw ZIP.
